principles: No gameplay-essential item, convenience feature, capacity upgrade, character slot, pet, or cosmetic is real-money-only in the target test build.
Every unlock has an explicit deterministic route; no paid-only random bundle and no duplicate cosmetic roll.
Use existing currencies/materials first; add at most one universal permanent-unlock token only if existing currencies cannot support fair progression.
Reward claims use stable event IDs and are idempotent.
Ads, if retained, remain optional and independent of essential progress.

currency_policy.gold: Earn from kills, boss clears, gear sales, repeatable contracts, and milestone rewards. Remove paid gold-pack routes only after economy tests.
currency_policy.existing_crafting_materials: Use existing crystals, mythstones and other materials for crafting where the original game supports them.
currency_policy.adventure_marks: Optional account-wide token from first-clear milestones, achievements and repeatable/weekly contracts; spend on permanent convenience unlocks rather than direct combat power.

starter_tuning_targets.first_extra_character_slot: By completion of Act I or the first major boss milestone
starter_tuning_targets.additional_character_slots: Successive campaign, completion and post-campaign challenge milestones
starter_tuning_targets.stash_upgrades: At least one campaign upgrade; later bounded cost curve
starter_tuning_targets.specific_cosmetic: Always direct selection, no duplicate requirement
starter_tuning_targets.boosts: Earnable/craftable with visible duration and stacking rules

migration_requirements: Map SKU to verified grant/effect, not prefix alone.
Migrate previously purchased entitlements only from legitimate persisted ownership state.
Unknown SKUs stay in review; do not auto-grant or auto-delete.
Reward, wallet, inventory and unlock updates use one transaction.
Test fresh and legacy saves, duplicate callbacks, interrupted writes, restores and offline mode.
